question: Does MongoDB earn a bounded Odin document primitive by materially outperforming the strongest tested PostgreSQL design while preserving the same contract?
tier: synthetic native single-host candidate screening; not production adoption

runtime.platformBoundary: macOS native comparison; observed PostgreSQL fsync_writethrough required before measurement. Mongo pinned WiredTiger source attempts F_FULLFSYNC, but actual syscall branch and power-loss recovery are not traced or tested.
runtime.durabilityVerification: Read live PostgreSQL settings and Mongo configuration before adapter mutation and at run end; reject setting drift, PGOPTIONS overrides, pending PostgreSQL restart, or the pinned WiredTiger full-flush fallback warning in the owned Mongo log. Absence of a warning is not syscall tracing.

A.contract: bounded aggregate CAS state; no durable historical receipt or business-event guarantee
A.sizeMeaning: cold-body bytes; full serialized documents include identity/version/nested-state overhead

B.contract: tenant-scoped scalar attribute predicates and ordered identifier/value projections; full match oracle outside timing
B.queryPolicy: two fixed seeded cases per group/class; positive fixtures chosen deterministically before timing; negative/type/absent controls separate

decision.compareAgainst: both PostgreSQL designs separately within each profile/size or query cell; a win against JSONB alone is not a PostgreSQL win
decision.maintenanceVeto: for attribute-query candidates, update median latency may not exceed the best PostgreSQL design by more than 2x; report ingestion and index build separately
decision.correctnessVeto: any missing acknowledged effect, incorrect reconstructed field/query, mismatched-tenant/id access, failed negative control or source drift rejects candidate
decision.reproductionGate: candidate must retain direction and at least30percent median reduction against both PostgreSQL designs in the independent one-repetition full-matrix repeat, with correctness and p95/storage gates; this is screening replication, not statistical generalization
decision.p95Aggregation: median of five paired per-cell p95 ratios, separately against each PostgreSQL design
decision.storageAggregation: maximum paired data-plus-index ratio across repetitions, separately against each PostgreSQL design
decision.queryClassPolicy: evaluate fixed mixed workload and every prespecified group/class separately, report all; no class claim inferred from pooled median

measurement.timed: direct adapter request/response including driver serialization and any required reconstruction
measurement.excluded: fixture generation, expected-state/query oracle computation, evidence hashing, Temporal orchestration; no full-document pre-read/validation before partial update
measurement.order: fixed Latin-square arm rotation per repetition and profile, identical per-lane operation traces across designs
measurement.statistics: per-cell request p50/p95 and throughput; five paired repetition ratios, all cells shown; no population tail or production capacity inference
measurement.storage: data plus all required indexes per design, after maintenance; WAL/oplog measurements separately named and never ratioed as equivalent write amplification
measurement.host: record shared host load and CPU speed limits; no heavy owned test/build jobs during measurement
measurement.authorizationBoundary: tenant-key scoping only, not independently authenticated identity or database-enforced tenant isolation
measurement.snapshotEvidence: full actual snapshot is compared independently in memory; stored session evidence retains hot/tools/core and cold-body byte length/SHA256 plus full-snapshot digest; cold bodies are reproducible from frozen fixture source/seed, not repeated in every export
measurement.throughput: whole-cell harness throughput includes trace bookkeeping; per-request latency excludes oracle work

temporalIntegration.contract: real activity execution, commit-before-ack retry and bounded CAS reconciliation on isolated known states; not general exactly-once receipts or a Mongo Temporal history backend

operatingDecision.scope: bounded session/artifact aggregate and tenant-defined metadata search candidates only
unmeasured: total operating cost and migration break-even
change-stream vs PostgreSQL logical decoding recovery contract

amendment.reason: Initial counted run discovered macOS flush-method confound: PostgreSQL default open_datasync versus MongoDB WiredTiger source attempting F_FULLFSYNC. Initial run interrupted and excluded; exact original sources and records retained.
amendment.comparisonPolicy: Restart entire main matrix and independent reproduction under required PostgreSQL fsync_writethrough; never pool earlier rows. Decision thresholds, workloads, seeds and denominators unchanged.
amendment.registration: Locally frozen before amended counted run; not publicly preregistered.
